sources.fact: LBBD material identifies HZ Hertford Road Industrial Estate for residential and/or industrial intensification and co-location, with 957 homes and/or 30,244 sqm industrial floorspace.
The adopted Local Plan 2037 is the starting point for decision-making; allocation status is policy evidence and is not planning permission.
The adopted Local Plan and London Plan form the development plan used to assess applications; development-plan inclusion is not an issued site consent.
The adopted plan identifies Hertford Road among the borough's industrial-land designations; co-location therefore requires industrial-land and residential policy reconciliation.
Plan-level HRA material places HZ about 5.0 km from Epping Forest SAC and within the plan-level in-combination assessment context.
Plan-level HRA context is not a project-specific appropriate assessment and cannot determine a candidate-specific permission outcome.
Regulation-19 sustainability material considers release of part of HZ industrial land within alternative industrial-release scenarios; scenario modelling is not an application decision.
Planning Data records Appendix 2 Site Allocation Proformas as a development-plan document effective from adoption; this document type is policy evidence, not a case register.
Planning Data records the adopted policies map as a development-plan document; mapped policy designation is distinct from legal title or application red-line geometry.
LBBD directs site-specific status checks to the applications and decisions service; this wave did not verify an exact current HZ application reference.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites still require planning permission; allocation/capacity cannot substitute for consent.
Planning Data spatial tools support discovery/intersection but do not justify turning a site point or policy area into an exact HMLR title relation.

examples.result: 957 homes is allocation capacity, not consented units.
30,244 sqm industrial floorspace is co-location/intensification capacity, not evidence of delivery.
HZ industrial-land release scenarios are not planning permissions.
Plan-level Epping Forest HRA context is not a project-specific refusal or approval signal.
No exact current HZ application reference was guessed from nearby Wickes or Harts Lane cases.
Policy-map geometry is not an HMLR legal parcel polygon.
Industrial co-location policy is not converted into a future-growth score without executed site evidence.
Promotion remains zero until exact HZ application/site/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
